text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "Summer Training Camp." During this period, to prepare for the upcoming GⅠ race, the Kikuka Sho, Agnes Tachyon's abilities must be elevated even further――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—...was what I had planned to do, yet for some reason,
Agnes Tachyon was making me do strength training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
141, 142... yes, just a little more!
Put more spirit into it, Guinea Pig!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even with it being "Summer Training Camp," the days continued to be spent entirely on experiments as usual...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...149, 150! All right, stop!
Now let's check your endorphins...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Just then, several reporters came running over."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You're Agnes Tachyon-san, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's true, but could you please
wait until later?! Right now, I'm finishing up an experiment—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Could you give us the detailed reasons
behind withdrawing from the "Laurel Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before summer training camp, she made the unilateral decision
to withdraw from the Laurels Cup at the last minute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because it was positioned as a special race meant to invigorate the Umamusume world, the ripples spread far and wideâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were also voices pointing out
her lack of responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good grief. I did think I saw an unfamiliar face mixed in at the summer training camp, but...
choice_data_list: Any interviews will have to go through the academy first—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I stepped in to intervene, the microphones
that had been pointed at her all turned toward me at once.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer,
are you aware of the complications caused
by her withdrawal from the race?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
There are rumors that, despite being enrolled at Tracen Academy,
she lacked any enthusiasm for making her debut.
choice_data_list: Like I said, please go through the official interview procedures—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
He's more of a guinea pig than a Trainer.
Directing your questions to me would be far more constructive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She is more of a guinea pig than a Trainer.
It would be far more constructive to direct your questions to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The microphones surrounded Agnes Tachyon once again.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Then, as a single talented Umamusume,
have you ever thought about the future and responsibilities of the Umamusume world?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I can't puff out my chest with pride. I'm not like the President.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"However, if that is the question you pose,
then allow me to ask one in return."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even if you get me to say something here,
will it contribute anything to the future of the Umamusume world?
Could you tell me what significance this time holds?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I despise wasted time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the flustered reporters behind,
Agnes Tachyon turned on her heel.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go, my guinea pig?
Today doesn't seem well suited for research.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the frustrated looks on the reporters' faces,
a flicker of unease crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
'The problem child of the Uma Musume world, Agnes Tachyon'
Hehehe…… What an interesting provocation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"At summer training camp, she indulged in experiments to her heart's content.
Calling her Trainer a guinea pig, using them as a harsh experimental tool..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
'With a shallow attitude that the future of the
Uma Musume world has nothing to do with her'――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, amazing! There's plenty of malice, but not a single lie written here!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She is smiling, but...
there's no guarantee this situation won't negatively impact her racing career moving forward."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, we still haven't heard the reason why
she withdrew from the Laurel Cup in the first place."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, Trainer-kun?
You're making an awfully grim face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, well, curious after all, are you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you know next to nothing.
As a trainer, that's an abnormal state of affairs.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, for now... unavoidable
circumstances keep me tied up. I'll report back once I have results!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And as expected, she didn't seem inclined to explain the reason.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if I remain completely in the dark,
I won't be able to protect her when the time comes."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Worried, huh? Hmm...
Come to think of it, that's just the kind of person you are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Let me mention one thing:
this choice was made after taking the lack of shared information into account.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, declining the Laurel Cup
has its own grand justification.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that said, she looked me straight in the eye. Though her tone was light, her expression was unusually serious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If everything goes well,
I'll tell you properly. I can promise you that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, she didn't seem thoughtless like the article
claimed. In her own way, she undoubtedly had
some sort of plan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I gave a small nod and said, "Understood,"
she smiled in relief.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Now that that's settled, off to the beach!
The weather's clear and humidity is optimal! Perfect for an experiment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Don't make such a sour face!
If all goes well, we'll wrap up today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, at long last—
Plan A has finally entered the testing phase!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a choice today!
Strength training or beach running,
which would you prefer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty!
Then keep count for me from over there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, of course it is.
You've become quite desensitized to this, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Verifying Plan A
requires my own physical body, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, do you have your counter ready?
Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day, for the first time in a long while, I watched her train.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Heh-heh, heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Perfect! No problems whatsoever!
It's finally, finally complete—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having exceeded her target reps,
she collapsed onto the sandy beach—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's a success...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She simply smiled as she said it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll do laps along the beach, so time my splits!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
You've become quite desensitized to this, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Verifying Plan A
requires my own physical body, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Got your stopwatch ready?
Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, she dashed off. Her slender back was swallowed up beyond the beach in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, hahahaha...!
Yes! At last, I have it in my grasp—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon her return, her eyes shone brilliantly.
It was a fierce, intense glare I hadn't seen in a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After catching my breath for a while, I collapsed onto the sandy beach—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's a success...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, a smile broke across their face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day.
She officially declared her entry into the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The backlash and online flaming over the out-of-context clip showing her lack of seriousness were intense, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
Though to be fair, they didn't write any lies.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as expected, she didn't pay it any mind at all.
